tests.name: group routes are mounted and refuse an unsigned caller (read-only)

tests.reason: sending a group message is a write, so the push it produces is proven here: the generic new_chat_message push (and the mention push) deep-links to /inbox/g/<groupId>/msg/<messageId>; every group-message push site (send fanout, welcome re-fanout, ORB voice send) carries the message id. The app side (landing on that message, also when the document scrolls) is verified in the community-app staging suite (exafyltd/vitana-v1 docs/validation/VTID-04928).
